title: Time Flora
text: Small patches of Time Grass and Time Flowers grow in Fleeting Woods. Using an Unstable Spacetime Aggregate on any temporal silt also sprouts these plants and consumes the aggregate.
An Advanced Condensation Table condenses a Time Flower into a Time Warp Point. Shears or Silk Touch harvest Time Grass; breaking it normally has a 5% chance to drop a Seed of Time.
Harvested flora can be placed on any Temporal Silt variant. Green and white motes also orbit the items.
